data.name: Snorkel Safari
data.headline: 8 and up! • Up to 6 People • 6 Hours
data.description:
Booking minimum of 3 adults.

Join us for a snorkel safari! We'll take you out on a photo safari off of San Diego, where you can get up close and personal with incredible marine wildlife in and out of the water!
data.itinerary:
1.) Meet at 1677 Quivira Rd, at Seaforth Marina gate
2.) Safety briefing at boat
3.) Gear up at dock, usually half-way put on wetsuit, stage snorkel gear.
3.) Leave out of Mission Bay to look for marine life in the Pacific Ocean!
4.) Snorkel with incredible marine life!
5.) Return to Seaforth Marina.

meeting_point.address: 1677 Quivira Rd San Diego, CA US 92109

data.cancellation_notes: Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 72 hours notice of cancellation. Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price.
data.booking_notes:
###What to Bring
We recommend bringing underwater cameras, snorkel gear, sunscreen, and warm clothes. Topside cameras are always recommended, as may find whales and dolphins on our way to the next adventure.
